description: Election Commission - R. Venuraj was elected as the member of the Ward No. 07 Kurumanvelly of Manmunai South and Eruvil Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Pradeshiya Sabha) due to the death of an elected member. It specifically operates under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and involves the nomination and declaration of a new elected member. This content directly relates to electoral processes and the composition of an elected body, fitting the definition of an Elections Gazette (Type 7).
